title: Every released policy on the current guest
description: Each of the 198 .onnx assets of the 39 model-* releases (experiments/onnx-compat.tsv), downloaded and run alone for 8 s on one link (24 then 12 Mbit/s, 20 ms one way, 100 packets) by the guest at this commit. The question is only whether every policy we have still runs: the episode ends ok and every step's applied action is a number. onnx-compat.md lists each policy with the contract inputs its graph reads (obs, state, truth, cwnd), its status and any failure reason, and its mean and spread of applied action and its utilization.
run: uv run python experiments/onnx_compat.py plan "$TAG" "$OUT/$TAG" && uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/$TAG/campaign.json" "$OUT/$TAG/c" && (uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/$TAG/c" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps || echo "$TAG: an episode failed; onnx-compat.md reports it"); rm -rf "$OUT/$TAG/policies"
